note: The intermediate files a film project holds, one entry a kind: what each is, who writes and reads it, when it must exist, how it is told out of date, what bin/vh clean does with it. bin/vh artifacts prints this table (spec) and holds a project against it (list); tools/ci.sh holds it to tools/commands.json, tools/clean.py and tools/schemas/ (bin/vh artifacts check). A new kind of file gets an entry here (CONTRIBUTING.md). Fields: id; path, relative to the project (<lang> a language such as zh; <n> a review page's name; <id> one folder name; <film> a video's path, under out/ at any depth, media/ or renders/; * anything within one folder name; a folder ends with /); also, other names for the same thing, with note saying which wins; kind (file, folder); format; stages (as in tools/commands.json, the first the main one); purpose, one plain Chinese line; made_by (person, agent, tool); writers and readers (commands of tools/commands.json, and page for what a film's page reads); required (null, or when it must exist: new, gate-1, gate-2, gate-3, narration, delivery); version_key (version, v, null); schema (a path, or null); stale (null, or {from: ids, by: sha256 or size_mtime, recorded_in: where}); made_from, only where stale is null: ids it is made from when nothing records which, so bin/vh artifacts list says not checked; clean (what bin/vh clean does with it, in tools/clean.py's terms: rebuilt, versions, renders and sound go, the last two only once it has found the film; film and stays stay); doc (a file, #section for a markdown one); note. ignored_writes: paths of tools/commands.json's writes that are no kind of file, each with why. Fields are only added.
